summary: Configured a dedicated private link (eth1) between node1 (OpenWrt) and node2 (AlmaLinux), previously unconfigured, and applied tc traffic shaping on node1's eth1 (tbf egress + ingress police, both 1Mbit/s) so node2's traffic through node1 is capped to ~1Mbit/s in each direction, while node1's own traffic on its other interface (br-lan, e.g. to node3) remains unshaped at full speed (~120 Gbit/s). Verified with iperf3 measured transfers in both directions. Shaping is persisted via an OpenWrt hotplug script that reapplies tc rules on interface ifup, and survives node reboot. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id/health on all 3 nodes, restarted them one at a time (node1, then node2, then node3), confirmed each node's boot_id changed after restart, and verified recovery of the private-link connectivity and the 1Mbit/s shaping after node1 and node2 restarted.
actions_performed: Inspected topology: node1 (OpenWrt, br-lan on eth0) and node2 (AlmaLinux) each have an unconfigured second NIC eth1
Configured static IP 192.168.50.1/24 on node1 eth1 via UCI network.priv interface
Configured static IP 192.168.50.2/24 on node2 eth1 via nmcli
Added OpenWrt firewall zone 'priv' with input/output ACCEPT, forward REJECT for the priv interface to allow inbound test traffic without exposing forwarding
Installed iperf3 on node1 (apk), node2 and node3 (dnf) for measurement
Measured unshaped baseline throughput on the private link (~80-120 Gbit/s)
Installed tc-tiny, kmod-sched-act-police, kmod-ifb on node1 (OpenWrt/apk)
Applied tc qdisc tbf (1mbit) as egress shaper on node1 eth1
Applied tc ingress qdisc + u32 police filter (1mbit, drop) on node1 eth1 for ingress shaping
Verified via iperf3 in both directions (node2->node1 and node1->node2 reverse) that throughput is capped to ~0.9-1.3 Mbit/s
Verified node1's own traffic to node3 over br-lan remains unshaped (~119 Gbit/s), after temporarily opening firewalld port 5201 on node3 for the test then closing it again
Persisted the tc shaping via /etc/hotplug.d/iface/95-shape-eth1 script triggered on ifup of the priv interface, so it reapplies after reboot
Captured pre-restart boot_id, uptime, interface state, and tc state as baseline for node1, node2, node3

Restarted node1 via 'reboot', polled until exec available again, confirmed changed boot_id, confirmed eth1 IP and tc shaping rules were automatically reapplied via hotplug script, re-verified ~1Mbit/s shaping still in effect with iperf3
Restarted node2 via 'reboot', polled until exec available again, confirmed changed boot_id, confirmed eth1 static IP persisted, re-verified ping and shaped iperf3 throughput to node1
Restarted node3 via 'reboot', polled until exec available again, confirmed changed boot_id, confirmed connectivity to node1 recovered
